name: SNDF_LOOP
meaning: Sound_Play sets StaticSound.looping (also forced by SndBankEntry.loop == 1)

name: SNDF_POSITIONAL
meaning: Sound_UpdateChannelGain attenuates by distance from owner+0xc/+0xe/+0x10 to g_camPos

name: SNDF_DIST_HORIZONTAL
meaning: distance uses x and z only (vertical ignored)

name: SNDF_NO_RETRIGGER
meaning: Sound_Play returns the existing handle if the same owner already has this soundId active; the default Load_SND gives every channel
